It's nice to be able to skip between songs using the arrow keys, but it would also be handy to be able to jump directly to a song by clicking on it. If this generates a random playlist every time, it might be useful to have a “refresh” button to generate a new one with the same settings

Beautiful and straight forward layout. The “day and night” mode is great! The app is easy to use, especially the option of choosing all genre is very nice to discover nice music I’d never find by myself.

I'm not sure if it was some sort of glitch or if it comes from YouTube, but I ended up having metal suggested to me in the Jazz section. The metal songs did not have the "Jazz" tag though, which makes me think this might have been a glitch. 
And a very minor thing, when using the system on a phone, the word "Experimental" on the genre selection page is cut off. While it's not detrimental to the use of the app, it might not look clean enough to some users, making them move to another product that offers the same service but is looking more polished. (No cut-offs on the desktop version of the app.)

Hello, 

The App mostly recommended me bands and songs I liked and seems to work well overall.

- I think it could benefit a sub-genre system (such as "heavy", "death", "melodic" under the "Metal" category, for example). Or maybe a larger list (4 songs is not a lot for such a vast category as Rock, up to 8-10 could offer more variety?). 
- I was occasionnaly recommended songs from a different genre several times, mostly in the Jazz category.
- It could be nice to be able to bookmark songs, as it's easy to reset the playlist and it doesn't seem possible to restore previous recommendations.

That's all, thank you! And good luck :)
